job.question: Which retirement plan's investment consulting RFP requires that, as of December 31, 2024, the firm have at least three public fund clients each with at least $1B in assets and have been in business at least ten years?
job.expected_facts: The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (Chicago Transit Authority), in its April 29, 2025 investment consulting RFP.
job.acceptance: Retirement Plan for CTA/Chicago Transit Authority Employees; publication date is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2022 Oklahoma OPERS RFP, not the Retirement Plan for CTA Employees RFP. Its qualifications require five public pension plans with at least $1 billion each as of June 30, 2021, and ten years of experience for senior investment professionals—not ten years in business for the firm.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-22-200 INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES
OPERS RFP – Investment Consulting Services – Issued February 18, 2022
The proposed investment consultant must have acted as full-service consultant to at least five public pension plans, each with at least $1 billion in assets, as of June 30, 2021.
The senior investment professionals in charge of the proposed consulting services must have at least ten years of institutional consulting experience within the industry.
